text:
maria: Heads-up: deployed SEQLEN-bucketing microbatcher (canary).
maria: Short: we infer approximate sequence length at request start, assign to buckets, and pack homogeneous microbatches. Canary numbers: p50 latency -21.9%, p99 down ~34ms, token cost -13.8% on generation-heavy traffic.

sanjay: Nice. Which models/traffic?

maria: Canary: 5% traffic on one shard group. Models: redwood/4k-q, rw-chat-13b, rw-7b-quant. Also ran synthetic replay of top prompt templates.

deploy-bot: Canary complete 1735550028. Health checks green. Metrics vs baseline: p50 -21.9%, p95 -18.5%, p99 -34.2ms, token-cost -13.8%.

alex: Observability: ~17% better GPU occupancy on microbatcher fleet. Largest wins on short-answer workloads.

jess: Any regressions on streaming? early bucketing could affect partial outputs.

maria: Ran ~1k evals (QA + summarization). Quality within noise (<0.2%). Safety fallback: if prefix-score drops >0.5% -> auto-fallback to batcher.v1.

ryan: Rollout plan?

maria: Plan: 5% -> 20% (12h) -> 50% (24h) -> 100% (48h). Ops oncall briefed.

ops-bot: Added dashboards: seqlen-batcher.p99_latency, seqlen-batcher.token_cost_delta, seqlen-batcher.quality_delta. Alert if p99 > baseline+50ms for 10m or quality_delta > 0.5%.

sanjay: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7921
sanjay: config:
```
microbatcher:
  strategy: seqlen
  estimator: seqlen-lite
  buckets: 6
  max_wait_ms: 15
  fallback: batcher.v1
```

maria: Tagging @sanjay and @alex for post-rollout smoke tests. Repro locally: `tools/bench/replay --prompts top10 --target seqlen-canary`.

alex: Great work team! :rocket:

jess: I'll update runbooks and draft support FAQ.

maria: I'll post formal graphs in #eng-runtime tomorrow.
